caseStudies.title: Peanut allergy and allergic rhinitis in a school-age child

exhibits.title: Allergy clinic
exhibits.body: A 9-year-old child had hives and lip swelling after eating a cookie with peanuts last month. The child also has a runny nose, sneezing and itchy eyes every spring and takes diphenhydramine, which makes the child sleepy at school.

caseStudies.title: Cough and cold drugs in COPD and in a young child

exhibits.title: Family clinic
exhibits.body: A 68-year-old client with COPD and hypertension has thick sputum and a cough after a cold and has been taking an over-the-counter decongestant with pseudoephedrine. The client's 3-year-old grandchild has a cough, and a relative suggested giving the client's codeine cough syrup.

exhibits.title: Transplant clinic
exhibits.body: A 52-year-old client had a liver transplant 10 weeks ago (donor CMV positive, recipient negative) and takes tacrolimus, mycophenolate and prednisone. Valganciclovir prophylaxis was stopped last week. The client has fever, diarrhea and tiredness.

exhibits.title: 28 weeks
exhibits.body: A 30-year-old client (G2 P1, one previous vaginal birth) at 28 weeks had a small painless bleed this morning. Ultrasound shows a marginal placenta previa. The bleeding has stopped.
